g=[[4]*w for _ in range(h)]
def line(r,c,color,dr=1,dc=1):
    while 0<=r-dr<h and 0<=c-dc<w: r-=dr;c-=dc
    while 0<=r<h and 0<=c<w:

        r+=dr;c+=dc
# paired line segments, add ones first

    r,c=r1,c1
    while True:
        if g[r][c]==4:g[r][c]=col
        if (r,c)==(r2,c2):break
        r+=dr;c+=dc
# isolated markers full slope +1 diagonals
for r,c,col in [(4,14,1),(17,9,1),(7,14,6),(15,2,6)]:line(r,c,col)
# restore all given markers
